findings.description: Taxon cladograms are human-readable illustrative strings, not linked taxonomic graph IDs. Many display informal groups and example names not backed by explicit taxon records. Raw strings and line arrays are preserved; no parent_taxon_id has been invented.
findings.resolution: Reconcile cladogram claims with Shared Taxa canonical identifiers and current phylogenetic sources.

findings.description: The widget contains 580 direct interval-to-taxon links and a separate age-filter predicate producing 8916 computed UI matches. The latter must NOT be treated as authoritative ranges, validated evolutionary first appearances, fossil observations or equivalent curated associations.
findings.resolution: Keep curated links and inferred matches separate until scholarly range reconciliation.

findings.description: The source contains no numeric organism population estimates and no taxonomic subdivision counts. The taxon export contains explicit nulls rather than fabricated values. Geologic subdivision_count is computed from actual child IDs.
findings.resolution: Add sourced fields during Shared Taxa enrichment, not at extraction.

findings.description: Only 100 taxon profiles supply numeric first/last fields; these are approximate widget ranges, not precise phylogenetic origination or extinction dates. Others remain null.
findings.resolution: Normalize later with calibrated first fossil records and qualified uncertainty.

findings.description: Example status strings are heterogeneous: some say extinct, living, historical, fossil, or refer to relatives. The status of a sampled example does not safely establish extinction of the parent group. Raw labels are preserved, taxon-level status is null pending review.
findings.resolution: Determine extinction at appropriate phylogenetic level and separate example from lineage status.

findings.description: The widget cites the ICS 2026/06 chronostratigraphic chart globally and identifies artwork as illustrative AI-generated paleoart. No source citations or source URLs are attached to individual taxa, example dates, climatic statements, or maps.
findings.resolution: Add verifiable per-record bibliographic references in canonical dataset.

findings.description: The 7 map SVG shape groups are hand-drawn approximate visualization presets selected by midpoint-age thresholds, not time-resolved georeferenced reconstructions.
findings.resolution: Replace with age-matched published reconstructions with license and scholarly citation.

findings.description: Some environmental text is inherited from broader parent intervals. Atmosphere and paleogeographic time slices are selected by hard-coded age thresholds. The exported interval fields and separate source_logic.json preserve this distinction.
findings.resolution: Retain provenance on inherited claims; source calibrated proxy data when available.

findings.description: 23 unique embedded generated images are stored losslessly as extracted image files and referenced by stable keys. Illustrations are not verified specimen images. Multiple example cards reuse the same key; some examples have emoji only.
findings.resolution: Cross-link imagery to actual taxa, credits, and licenses before canonical reuse.

findings.description: Ranks mix formal Linnaean units, clades, assemblages and historical/informal grades; names may be polyphyletic, deprecated, or broadly defined. The original classification strings are retained verbatim.
findings.resolution: Choose accepted definitions and preserve synonyms and editorial notes.
